import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def signals(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Deleveraging-exhaustion fade (5m, closed bars only).

    A bar whose range and volume are both extreme vs the trailing 48-bar
    baseline (baseline shifted by one bar so the current bar is excluded)
    is treated as a forced-liquidation burst. Fade it: short after an
    up-burst, long after a down-burst. Entry happens at the next bar open
    (screen.simulate convention).
    """
    rng = (df["high"] - df["low"]) / df["close"]
    vol = df["volume"].astype(float)
    base_rng_mu = rng.rolling(48, min_periods=48).mean().shift(1)
    base_rng_sd = rng.rolling(48, min_periods=48).std().shift(1)
    base_vol_mu = vol.rolling(48, min_periods=48).mean().shift(1)
    base_vol_sd = vol.rolling(48, min_periods=48).std().shift(1)
    z_rng = (rng - base_rng_mu) / base_rng_sd.replace(0, np.nan)
    z_vol = (vol - base_vol_mu) / base_vol_sd.replace(0, np.nan)
    burst = (z_rng > 3.0) & (z_vol > 3.0)
    body = df["close"] - df["open"]
    sig = pd.Series(0, index=df.index, dtype="int64")
    sig[burst & (body > 0)] = -1
    sig[burst & (body < 0)] = 1
    return sig.fillna(0).astype("int64")
